summary: Tower at the entrance of Roosevelt State Park near Morton, MS: a 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 run by the Mississippi Forestry Commission, NHLR-registered July 2023, with the build date given only as 1935-1940.

facts.agency: Mississippi Forestry Commission; cooperator Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks

access.note: Stands at the entrance of a public state park; the Register does not say whether the tower may be climbed

events.note: The Register gives the build date only as sometime between 1935 and 1940; 1935 is the start of that range, not a confirmed year
Register records a site visit on July 1, 2023

evidence.supports: tower is a 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 located at the entrance of the park
evidence.quote: This tower is a 100ft Aermotor LS-40 located at the entrance of the Roosevelt State Park.

evidence.supports: park is a public recreation area off Interstate 20 on the southwest side of Morton
evidence.quote: Roosevelt State Park is a public recreation area located off Interstate 20 on the southwest side of Morton

evidence.supports: park is a Mississippi state park
evidence.quote: The state park surrounds 150-acre Shadow Lake

evidence.supports: tower is administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission
Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks is a cooperator
evidence.quote: The Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks (MDWFP)

evidence.supports: build date given only as a range of 1935 to 1940
Wikipedia gives 1935 as the year the park was established
CCC began work on the park in August 1935 and the park opened in April 1940
evidence.quote: The CCC began work August 1935; the park opened in April 1940.

evidence.supports: CCC occupied the site from August 1935 to the park's opening in April 1940
evidence.quote: 1935 to the park's opening in April 1940.

evidence.supports: nomination describes nine CCC-built cabins, a pavilion and landscape features, with no tower named
evidence.quote: Nine park cabins, a park pavilion, and a few landscape features such as stairwells and culverts were built by the CCC.

corrections.why: The NHLR detail page gives the build as a range, 'sometime between 1935-1940', not a single year
The NHLR detail page describes the structure as a 100ft Aermotor LS-40 tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia gives 1935 as the park's established year. The Register gives the tower's build as sometime between 1935 and 1940. The park's CCC work began in August 1935, so the two dates describe different things and both are kept.

sources.title: Roosevelt State Park Historic District, National Register of Historic Places nomination (NRHP 97001436)

notes_for_editor: Standing is inferred from the Register's 2023 site visit and present-tense description, not from a condition report. The build year is only a range, 1935-1940. The NRHP nomination for the park historic district does not mention any lookout tower, so the tower is not documented as part of the CCC park development. A Living New Deal page on the park returned 403 and was not used. No fire or staffing history was found. Corrections: the brief's single build year of 1935 and its kind of unknown.
